programme_name: Deep phylogenetic structure of family-level trait-memory context

relationship_to_prior_work.role: Post-outcome complementary analysis. It cannot alter, rescue, or reclassify any prospective primary result.
relationship_to_prior_work.motivation: The prospective analyses show a modest recurring family context but explicitly do not establish continuous deep-phylogeny covariance among families.

question: Are family-level shifts in within-family phylogenetic memory themselves similar among evolutionarily related plant families, or is family context phylogenetically mosaic?

source_core.selection: outcome-blind final crossed core from the prior prospective programme
source_core.real_effect_source: the exact S3 rho table already reproduced identically by three independent execution routes

family_context_score.definition: For each family x trait edge, centered_rho = rho_family_trait - mean(rho_other_families_same_trait). Family context score = median centered_rho across that family's admitted traits.
family_context_score.weighting: each trait edge contributes equally within family
family_context_score.rationale: Avoids using mixed-model BLUP shrinkage and removes trait-specific mean memory before asking about deep family relationships.

family_phylogeny.family_representative: For each of the 45 families, use the MRCA node of all backbone-native tips belonging to that family among the final-core species pool; if fewer than 2 native tips, use the single native tip only for location but mark family non-MRCA.
family_phylogeny.family_distance: patristic distance between family representative nodes on the unmodified GBOTB.extended.TPL

primary_exploratory_statistic.response_pair: absolute difference in family context score
primary_exploratory_statistic.statistic: Spearman rho over all unordered family pairs
primary_exploratory_statistic.expected_direction_if_deep_phylogenetic_: positive: more distant families have more different context scores
primary_exploratory_statistic.permutation: 9999 complete permutations of family context scores over fixed family-tree positions

robustness: Repeat using family context mean instead of median.
Repeat after leave-one-trait-out recomputation of all family context scores; report range of Spearman rho.
Repeat using prune-only memory rho instead of S3 rho.

interpretation.significant_positive: Family context shows continuous deep-phylogenetic structure beyond discrete family identity.
interpretation.null_or_weak: Recurring family context is not detectably organized by deeper family phylogeny at this resolution; treat it as clade-specific/mosaic rather than a smoothly inherited macroevolutionary regime.
interpretation.negative: Unexpected contrast: close families differ more in context score; exploratory only.

hard_nonclaims: A null result is not evidence that family context is random in every taxonomic hierarchy.
This post-outcome analysis cannot replace the prequalified portability or repeatability results.
No new family/trait filtering based on context scores.
